tvShow.name: Leanne
tvShow.overview: When her husband leaves her for another woman, a resilient Southern mom starts over with the support of her loving, but unfiltered family.

episodes.name: The Important Stuff
episodes.overview: Facing the abrupt end of her marriage, Leanne leans on her sister Carol, concocts cover stories and confronts the prospect of starting over in her 50s.

episodes.name: The Healing Magic of Family
episodes.overview: When Mama Margaret suffers a health scare, Leanne scrambles to keep the family from upsetting her by spilling the beans about Bill.

episodes.name: Oh, Knoxville
episodes.overview: It's ladies' night as Carol whisks Leanne out of her comfort zone and into a local hotspot for a crash course in confidence.

episodes.name: Smooth Like a Dolphin
episodes.overview: With a lawyer in one ear and Carol in the other, Leanne considers a fresh look and a new ride. An unwanted guest threatens to spoil game day.

episodes.name: A Plumber Sent from Heaven
episodes.overview: Leanne sets out to get fit, but temptation is hard to shake — especially after discovering that Carol has a midnight snack of her own.

episodes.name: Too Much Wedding Ring
episodes.overview: A visit from a charismatic law enforcement officer sets off sirens for Leanne. Daddy John finds a gender reveal party to be anything but a piece of cake.

episodes.name: Please Be a Lizard
episodes.overview: Leanne's routine gyno exam gets shaken up by a surprise encounter in the waiting room. Carol and Bill mellow out after sampling some enhanced goodies.

episodes.name: Muscle Memory
episodes.overview: Leanne gets hot and bothered — but not in the way she'd hoped. Carol and Tyler join their elders for an unexpectedly lively night at the movies.

episodes.name: Chipmunk in the Drywall
episodes.overview: A stack of treasured heirlooms resurfaces old sibling tensions. To keep an embarrassing truth under wraps, Mary agrees to mop up Carol's mess.

episodes.name: Apology Pie
episodes.overview: Concerned that Andrew's poker face might be masking something deeper, a suspicious Leanne ropes Carol into an undercover investigation.

episodes.name: Dog Day Afternoon
episodes.overview: As Leanne readies for an exciting step forward, Carol looks back — and realizes her love life could use some serious quality control.

episodes.name: The Queen's Dilemma
episodes.overview: When Leanne's off-the-cuff speech at a local book club is caught on video, her empowering words turn out to be more powerful than anyone expected.

episodes.name: Don't Dangle a Dream
episodes.overview: Leanne vows to fulfill Mama Margaret's decades-old dream of a perfect wedding day. But when her rushed plans go off the rails, she'll have to improvise.

episodes.name: Gomez Is a Woman
episodes.overview: When a long-distance farewell hits close to home, Leanne finds herself rattled by a surprise introduction that stirs up insecurities — and jealousy.

episodes.name: Spiritual Airbags
episodes.overview: After a brush with fate, Leanne decides to tie up loose ends, Carol experiments with her softer side and Sunday service gets an unexpected reboot.

episodes.name: Having Big Feelings
episodes.overview: Whisked away for a surprise weekend of sun and sand, Leanne faces her first big relationship test. But an even bigger surprise awaits back at home.

episodes.name: The Big Hm-Hm
episodes.overview: On the eve of her birthday, Leanne must step in to help Mama Margaret and Daddy John after their forgetfulness leads to an alarming mishap at home.

episodes.name: A Prison of Love
episodes.overview: Leanne struggles to set boundaries as Mama Margaret and Daddy John begrudgingly stay at her house. A spilled secret throws Bill's life into chaos.

episodes.name: The Old Cat Had Her Reasons
episodes.overview: As her relationship takes a surprising turn, Leanne questions her own desires — and the women at her book club chime in with conflicting advice.

episodes.name: Fit as a Fiddle
episodes.overview: A trip to the doctor forces Leanne and Daddy John to have an overdue chat about the future — and helps Carol and Mama Margaret bond like never before.

episodes.name: Big Hammer Energy
episodes.overview: While Bill helps remodel her parents' kitchen, Leanne wrestles with her feelings. A garden project digs up trouble between Carol and Mama Margaret.

episodes.name: An Enhancement... Or Two
episodes.overview: After an awkward encounter, Leanne and Carol hit the road with Mary to recapture some of their youthful glow. Daddy John deals Bill in on poker night.

episodes.name: Pickles Are Forever
episodes.overview: Daddy John and Leanne butt heads during a visit to the estate lawyer. After exceeding expectations, Bill makes a case to continue remodeling the house.

episodes.name: Have a Rocky Top Day
episodes.overview: An unexpected guest visits Leanne, raising questions about love and second chances. Mama Margaret arranges a date for Carol with an eligible stranger.

episodes.name: Three Degrees of Southern Women
episodes.overview: At long last, Leanne starts speaking her mind — much to Mama Margaret's dismay. Bill tries to help Daddy John tune up his driving knowledge.

episodes.name: Bang Me
episodes.overview: As Leanne reaches the one-year mark of her separation, a heart-to-heart with her stylist helps reframe her perspective on the past and present.
